On VTES-L, VampC...@AOL.COM wrote:
> If a zip gun is used for a manuever, and the strike fizzles
> because of an immortal grapple, does the zip gun owner still
> take one damage?

No. Zip Gun only deals damage to the bearer when the bearer uses
it as his strike.
